prompt: The middle $50\%$ of the data sits between which two quartiles?
hint: Quartiles cut the sorted data into four equal parts, each holding about $25\%$ of the values.

hints.text: Quartiles cut the sorted data into four equal parts, each holding about $25\%$ of the values.
The lowest $25\%$ lies below the lower quartile and the highest $25\%$ lies above the upper quartile. What remains in between is the box of a box plot.
The middle $50\%$ of the data sits between $Q_1$ and $Q_3$.

explanation: The quartiles divide the ordered data into four parts with about $25\%$ of the values in each.
$Q_1$ has $25\%$ of the data below it, and $Q_3$ has $75\%$ of the data below it.
The part between them holds $75\% - 25\% = 50\%$, so the middle $50\%$ sits between $Q_1$ and $Q_3$.
